name: scene_get_tree
description: Return the current edited scene's node tree as nested JSON { name, class, path, children }. Paths use "." for root — pass them directly to other editor commands.

max_depth.description: Tree depth. Default 2. Use -1 for full tree.

include_properties.description: Embed property snapshot per node. Default false.

name: scene_create_node
description:
Create a node of class_name under parent. Supports engine + user-defined class_name classes. Idempotent: 'returned' on collision, 'created' on fresh.

Example: class_name: "CharacterBody2D", parent_path: ".", node_name: "Player"

layout_mode.description: Layout mode for Control nodes: 0=free, 1=anchors. Auto-sets 1 when parent is Container.

unique_name.description: Mark as scene-unique node for %Name access in scripts. Warns if name collides with existing unique node.

properties.description: Inline property values set after creation. Same coercion as node_set_property. Partial failure keeps the node — check properties_failed. Dict iteration order is not guaranteed.

name: scene_delete_node
description: Delete the node at path (NodePath). Refuses to delete the edited scene root.

name: scene_create
description: Create .tscn at file_path. Root name = filename stem at '.'. root_type default Node. Idempotent: created|returned|replaced. if_exists: return|fail|replace. Use scene_open afterward to edit.

root_name.description: Root node name override (default: filename stem).

name: node_get_property
description: Read a property from the node at path. Returns { value } (engine types are dict-wrapped).

property.description: Property name. Use ':' to chain into sub-resources (e.g. 'material:shader_parameter/value').

name: node_set_property
description:
Set a property on a node in the EDITOR scene tree (saved to .tscn files). Does NOT affect the running game — for runtime property changes during playtesting, use runtime_set_property.

Node paths are relative to the edited scene root: "." is root, "./Player" is a direct child, "./Player/Sprite2D" for deeper nodes.

Engine types: {type:'Vector2',x,y}. Inline sub-resources: {type:'NewResource',class:'CircleShape2D',properties:{radius:50}}. External resources (textures, audio, tilesets, materials): {type:'Resource', path:'res://path/to/file.tres'}. Packed arrays: {type:'PackedVector2Array', values:[{type:'Vector2',x:0,y:0}, ...]}. Collision layers: {type:'LayerMask', layers:[1,4,6]} (by number) or {type:'LayerMask', layers:['player','walls']} (by name from layer_names_set); optional category defaults to '2d_physics'. All supported type tags: Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, Vector2i, Vector3i, Color, Rect2, Rect2i, Transform2D, Transform3D, NodePath, Resource, NewResource, PackedVector2Array, PackedVector3Array, PackedColorArray, LayerMask. Unknown type tags are rejected with an error listing supported types.

Anchor presets: setting anchors_preset alone may not auto-apply underlying values. For reliable layout, set anchor_left/top/right/bottom and offset_left/top/right/bottom explicitly.

Batch mode: pass batch:[{node_path, property, value, make_unique?}, ...] to set multiple properties at once.

node_path.description: Single mode: path to target node

property.description: Single mode: property name. Compound '/' paths supported. Use ':' for sub-resource chaining (e.g. 'material:shader_parameter/value').

make_unique.description: When true and the compound path targets an external (.tres) sub-resource, auto-duplicate it as an inline copy before setting. Equivalent to the Inspector's 'Make Unique'. Only needed for compound paths on external resources.

batch.description: Batch mode: array of {node_path, property, value, make_unique?}. Omit for single-property operations. When present, top-level node_path/property/value are ignored.

make_unique.description: Per-entry make_unique — auto-duplicate external sub-resource as inline copy.

name: node_get_property_list
description: Introspect node properties. mask: common (default), all, groups, script. 'script' returns all script variables with public/private label; use visibility param to filter.

mask.description: Property filter. 'common' (default) returns 8-12 most-edited. 'all' returns full list. 'groups' returns names+usage only. 'script' returns script variables with visibility label. Prefer 'common' or node_get_property; 'all' returns the full list and is large.

visibility.description: Filter for mask='script'. 'public' = no _ prefix, 'private' = _ prefix, 'all' = both.

name: node_set_script
description: Attach a script (.gd/.cs) to a node. On Godot 4.2.2+, a .gd changed on disk since it was loaded is reloaded first, for every node running it. Returns @export properties. Empty script_path detaches.

name: control_set_layout
description: Set anchor preset + optional margins on a Control node in one call. Uses set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(). Returns final_rect.

preset.description: Layout preset: PRESET_TOP_LEFT, PRESET_TOP_RIGHT, PRESET_BOTTOM_LEFT, PRESET_BOTTOM_RIGHT, PRESET_CENTER_LEFT, PRESET_CENTER_TOP, PRESET_CENTER_RIGHT, PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM, PRESET_CENTER, PRESET_LEFT_WIDE, PRESET_TOP_WIDE, PRESET_RIGHT_WIDE, PRESET_BOTTOM_WIDE, PRESET_VCENTER_WIDE, PRESET_HCENTER_WIDE, PRESET_FULL_RECT

resize_mode.description: keep_size (default) preserves size; set_to_anchors resizes to anchor region.

margins.description: Additive offsets applied after the preset (in pixels).

name: node_call_method
description: Call method with args on an edited-scene node (editor-only; for runtime nodes use execute_code).

name: script_read
description: Read a script file (res:// only). Returns the file content as text in an <untrusted> envelope. Read large scripts in successive line windows via start_line/end_line (1-indexed, inclusive). Paged: returned, total_lines, has_more. When has_more, page via next_start_line until has_more is false.

start_line.description: 1-based first line (default 1); pass next_start_line back as start_line to page.

name: script_write
description: Write .gd/.cs/.gdshader/.gdshaderinc at file_path (res:// only, creates or overwrites). For .gd files, returns inline diagnostics (valid: bool, diagnostics: [...]) — check valid before proceeding. Not idempotent. Use script.delete to remove; resource.create for .tres; scene.create for .tscn.

name: script_edit
description: Surgically replace a span in an existing .gd/.cs/.gdshader/.gdshaderinc file (res:// only) — the MCP analogue of the native Edit tool. old_string must match the file byte-for-byte (whitespace and indentation included); no regex, no fuzzy match. old_string not found -> NOT_FOUND; matches more than once without replace_all -> NOT_UNIQUE. new_string:'' deletes the span. replace_all replaces every occurrence and returns replacements:N. edits applies several edits in order in one call, writing nothing if any fails. Prefer this over rewriting the whole file with script_write for a small change — it keeps the editor undo entry, reindexing, and inline diagnostics. For .gd files, returns inline diagnostics (valid: bool, diagnostics: [...]) — check valid before proceeding.

old_string.description: exact byte-for-byte span to replace (whitespace/indent must match); omit when passing edits

new_string.description: replacement text; empty string deletes the span; omit when passing edits

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match (default false)

edits.description: several edits in one call, instead of old_string/new_string/replace_all; each applies to the text the earlier ones leave, and nothing is written if any fails

name: script_check
description: Offline GDScript validation — pass/fail + diagnostics, each error with its line (1-based). Columns are lsp_diagnostics' domain. Works headless.

name: editor_save_scene
description: Save the current edited scene. Optional file_path triggers save-as.

name: scene_open
description: Open a scene (.tscn / .scn) as the active edited scene. res:// only; NOT_FOUND if the file doesn't exist.

name: project_get_settings
description: List ProjectSettings keys + values. Optional prefix filter. Keys matching /password|token|secret|key/i are dropped (MVP filter).

name: editor_get_console
description: Tail editor Output. source='buffer' (default): live editor console. source='file': the newest log — the game's, or the editor's own when launched with --log-file. level_filter, since_id, text_filter (is_regex=true for regex). Carries returned/total_lines/has_more + next_id — page via since_id. Primary post-crash diagnostic tool — reads runtime errors even after game_stop.

level_filter.description: Single level or array of levels to filter by

text_filter.description: Substring to match against message text (case-insensitive). Set is_regex=true for regex patterns.

is_regex.description: Treat text_filter as a regex pattern instead of a plain substring (default false).

clear_buffer.description: Clear the log buffer before reading. Use when stale errors persist after successful script recompilation.

name: project_set_setting
description: Write a ProjectSettings key and persist via ProjectSettings.save. Refuses mcp_toolkit/*, mcp/*, and editor/* prefixes. Returns previous_value. Update (no status).

name: folder_create
description: Create directory at res:// path (recursive — parents auto-created). Idempotent: status created on fresh, returned if pre-existing.

name: game_start
description: Start playtest. Blocks until runtime is ready by default; wait_for_runtime:false launches without blocking. scene_path:'main'|'current'(default)|res://path. if_running:'return' for idempotent mode.

wait_for_runtime.description: Defaults true — blocks until runtime connects (or times out) so runtime tools are immediately available. Pass wait_for_runtime:false to launch without blocking.

runtime_poll.description: With if_running:'return', re-check whether the already-running game's runtime has since connected. Default false.

name: game_stop
description: Stop the currently-playing scene (idempotent — returns was_running:false if nothing was running). No params.

name: runtime_screenshot
description: Capture the running game window. Requires an active playtest (game_start). Use editor_screenshot for the editor viewport. image_response_mode 'disk' saves the PNG and returns only its path.

save_path.description: Destination .png used by image_response_mode disk/both (user://screenshots/ only); auto-named when omitted.

image_response_mode.description: How to return the capture: 'inline' (default) embeds the PNG; 'disk' persists it and returns only the path — use for very large captures or to conserve context tokens; 'both' does both. Files written to disk are always full resolution, regardless of image_detail.

image_detail.description: Resolution of the returned inline image only. full = native; mid ˜ 1024 px long edge; low ˜ 512 px (gross layout/motion only — not for reading text). Does not affect files written to disk.

force_foreground_game.description: If true, un-minimize + raise/focus the game window before capturing (default false). Set it when runtime_screenshot reports RUNTIME_WINDOW_MINIMIZED; leave false to avoid fighting for focus (esp. parallel game instances).

name: debugger_get_log
description: Game output log. Works during gameplay AND after crash (auto-serves cached output). print()/push_* from a running game are captured here on every version (4.2-4.7) — the 'read my own prints to validate a flow' path. Compile errors will NOT appear here (the game must run); use script_check (one file) or lsp_project_diagnostics (whole project). source='buffer'|'file'. limit=200. text_filter + is_regex for search. +returned/total_lines/has_more (capped tail). Right after game_stop the first call may return GAME_NOT_RUNNING while the session registry settles — retry once (the cache serves the next call).

text_filter.description: Substring to match against log message text (case-insensitive). Set is_regex=true for regex.

is_regex.description: Treat text_filter as a regex pattern instead of a plain substring (default false).

name: input_simulate
description:
Inject input into the running game. events: single {event_type, event_data?, delay_before_ms?, delay_after_ms?} for one action, or an array for a sequence of actions (prefer a single call with multiple events over separate calls). Types: key|mouse_button|mouse_motion|action|click|click_node|send_text. click is a composite: press + 50ms delay + release via push_input (no OS focus/warp; parallel-safe). click_node takes {node_path} — calls grab_focus + emits pressed on BaseButtons (no coordinate guessing). send_text types a string into the focused text field (or the event_data.node_path-targeted Control) by synthesizing per-character key events via push_input, firing the real text_changed/text_submitted signals that setting .text skips. send_text event_data: text (required), node_path? (a Control to focus first), submit? (append Enter); it returns focus_target, focus_source, text_changed, text_after (secret fields redacted), chars_sent, and a hint.

Mouse coordinate modes:
- position: {x, y} — raw viewport/screen coordinates (default). Use for UI elements (buttons, menus).
- world_position: {x, y} — game-world coordinates, auto-translated via canvas transform (accounts for camera offset and zoom). Use for clicking at specific in-game locations.

Mouse events route through push_input (position + global_position) for CanvasLayer/GUI hit-testing — no OS focus/warp, parallel-safe. Returns per-event diagnostics.

name: runtime_get_script_vars
description: Get script variables (names, values, public/private) for a live game node. Complements runtime_get_node_state (engine props only). visibility param filters.

name: execute_code
description:
DANGER: evaluates a GDScript expression. Expression-only — no var/return/if/for statements, no = assignment.

channel: 'runtime' (default) runs in the running game, 'editor' runs in the editor process.

To set properties: get_node('/root/Main/Player').set('speed', 400)
To call methods: get_node('/root/Main/Player').call('take_damage', 25)
To read values: get_node('/root/Main/Player').position

Prefer runtime_set_property for single property changes (safer, no expression syntax). Use execute_code for complex multi-step operations or method calls with specific arguments. If C# project, managed methods are callable at runtime (channel:'runtime').

LIMITATION: Expression cannot access engine singletons (EditorInterface, Engine, OS, Input) or call load()/preload(). Property chaining on method return values (get_node('X').position) may fail due to Variant type erasure — use scope_path to bind the node as self, or use .get('property') instead (get_node('X').get('position') works reliably).

channel.description: 'runtime' (default) evaluates in the running game — needs game_start first, else GAME_NOT_RUNNING; 'editor' evaluates in the editor process, no running game needed — use it for editor-state expressions.

name: signal_list
description: List signals on a node. include_connections=true adds targets ({target_path, method_name, flags}). flags & 2 = CONNECT_PERSIST (saved in .tscn).

name: signal_manage
description: Connect or disconnect a signal (editor-time, CONNECT_PERSIST — saved in .tscn, survives save/load). Idempotent connect (status 'returned' on collision).

name: node_manage
description:
Structural node operations on the edited scene tree.

action: rename — requires new_name.
action: reparent — requires new_parent_path, optional keep_global_transform (default true).
action: reorder — requires new_index (0-based sibling index).
action: duplicate — optional new_name, parent_path, properties (overrides like {position:{x,y}}).

new_name.description: Required for rename; optional for duplicate.

keep_global_transform.description: For reparent: preserve world transform. Default true.

parent_path.description: For duplicate: target parent. Defaults to same parent.

properties.description: For duplicate: property overrides on the copy (e.g. {position:{x:100,y:200}}).

name: node_groups
description:
Manage node group membership. Groups are the idiomatic Godot way to tag and query game objects (e.g. 'coins', 'enemies').

Single mode: node_path + group (node_path required for add/remove/list). Batch mode: entries array of {node_path, group} carries per-item paths, and the top-level node_path/group are ignored.

action: add — requires group. action: remove — requires group. action: list — returns all groups (single only).

node_path.description: Single mode: target node path. Required for single add/remove/list; omit in batch mode (provide entries instead).

group.description: Group name. Required for single add/remove.

persistent.description: For add: save to .tscn. Default true.

entries.description: Batch mode (add/remove only): array of {node_path, group}. When present, processes all entries as a batch.node_path and group params are ignored in batch mode.

name: autoload_manage
description:
Manage project autoload singletons (GameManager, AudioManager, etc.). Writes to project.godot; takes effect on next game launch.

action: register — requires name + script_path. action: unregister — requires name. action: list — returns all.

enabled.description: For register: auto-initialize on startup. Default true.

name: scene_query
description: Search scene tree with filters (class, group, name glob, property conditions). Returns matching nodes. Faster than scene_get_tree + manual filtering. Paged: returned, total_matches, has_more. When has_more, page via next_offset until has_more is false. Stable only if the source is unchanged between calls. Results are returned in deterministic depth-first order; nodes echoes offset/limit. limit is 1-200 (default 50, clamped above 200). If the tree changes between paged reads (nodes added, removed, or reordered) results may skip or repeat — re-query from offset 0.

include_properties.description: Property names to include in results

offset.description: Skip the first N (default 0); pass next_offset back as offset until has_more is false.

limit.description: Page size (default per tool); a request above the cap is clamped and limit_clamped is set.

name: scene_spatial_map
description: Spatial layout of the current scene: per-node world position, bounds (2D Rect2 / 3D AABB), size, plus computed overlaps/gaps/containment. Call before placing or moving nodes to find clear space. Paged: returned, total_nodes, has_more. Cursor-less — narrow with subtree/class/region/radius or raise max_nodes for more.

detail.description: brief = position/size only; normal = + bounds + overlaps; full = + containment + nearest-neighbour gaps

class.description: Only include nodes of this class (ancestry-aware)

subtree.description: Map only this node and its descendants (node path relative to the scene root)

region.description: Only nodes intersecting this box: [x,y,w,h] (2D) or [x,y,z,sx,sy,sz] (3D)

radius.description: Only nodes within this distance of center

name: discover_tools
description: Find and activate tool groups by name or domain keyword. Activate only the groups needed for your current task (up to ~5) — loading many groups at once floods the tool list and degrades response quality. No params ? full catalog. reset: true ? deactivate ALL groups; reset: ['group_a'] ? deactivate only group_a. Groups: runtime_advanced [available] — Inspect live node state, set node properties, and control AnimationPlayer during playtests; signals [available] — Emit signals on scene nodes at editor-time or runtime; animation_authoring [available] — Inspect and author keyframes, edit tracks, and configure AnimationTree state machines; input_map [available] — List, create, and edit input actions and their key/controller bindings; resource_io [available] — Load and write Godot resources (.tres/.res) programmatically; asset_ops [available] — List assets, query dependencies, and import binary files into the project; placeholders [available] — Generate placeholder/prototype assets procedurally — textures (shapes, patterns, labels) and sound effects (tones, noise). No art or network needed.; cleanup [available] — Delete files, scripts, scenes, resources, and folders; close open scenes; user_data [available] — Read, write, delete, and list user:// save files; scene_advanced [available] — Diff scenes and batch-instantiate nodes from packed scenes; editor_advanced [available] — Capture editor screenshots, refresh the filesystem, and wait for idle; tilemap [available] — Read and paint cells on TileMap/TileMapLayer nodes — cell queries, bulk fills, and region operations; tileset [available] — Create TileSet resources, add atlas sources, configure layers, and manage tile alternatives; tileset_edit [available] — Edit per-tile properties: physics, terrain, navigation, visuals, and custom data; theme [available] — Edit UI theme overrides: styleboxes, fonts, colors, and constants; layer_naming [available] — Get and set physics, render, and navigation layer names; path_editing [available] — Edit Path2D curves and generate collision shapes from sprite textures; 3d_tools [available] — Create 3D primitives, lights, cameras, and environment setups; procedural [available] — Edit gradients, curves, and FastNoiseLite resources for procedural generation; scene_inheritance [available] — Create inherited scenes (variants) from base scenes; audio [available] — List and configure audio buses, effects, and volume settings; spriteframes [available] — List, create, and edit SpriteFrames animations and import from spritesheets; particles [available] — Create and configure GPU particle systems for visual effects; navigation [available] — Set up navigation regions, meshes, and obstacle avoidance; lsp_code_analysis [available] — GDScript diagnostics, symbols, hover info, and a project-wide compile check via the language server; lsp_code_navigation [available] — Code completion, go-to-definition, and find references via the language server; debugger [available] — Inspect debugger state, manage breakpoints, and control execution flow; classdb [available] — Search and inspect Godot class hierarchy — properties, methods, signals, inheritance.

request.description: Names or keywords to find tool groups. Built-in: runtime_advanced, signals, animation_authoring, input_map, resource_io, asset_ops, placeholders, cleanup, user_data, scene_advanced, editor_advanced, tilemap, tileset, tileset_edit, theme, layer_naming, path_editing, 3d_tools, procedural, scene_inheritance, audio, spriteframes, particles, navigation, lsp_code_analysis, lsp_code_navigation, debugger, classdb (plus extension groups).

activate.description: Auto-activate matching groups. Default true. Set false to browse without loading.

include_schemas.description: Include full parameter schemas and annotations in the response. Default false. Only needed when you activated a group but the new tools are missing from your tool list.

reset.description: Deactivate groups. true = reset ALL on-demand groups. Array of group names = selectively deactivate only those groups (e.g. reset: ["tilemap", "audio"]). false or omitted = keep current groups active.

name: extensions_refresh
description: Force a filesystem rescan and re-discover extension scripts. Call after creating, modifying, or deleting extension files from outside the Godot editor. Returns the updated list of extension commands.
